SELECT T1.final_result, AVG(T2.score) FROM studentInfo AS T1 INNER JOIN studentAssessment AS T2 ON T1.id_student = T2.id_student INNER JOIN assessments AS T3 ON T1.code_module = T3.code_module AND T1.code_presentation = T3.code_presentation AND T2.id_assessment = T3.id_assessment GROUP BY T1.final_result
